text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by the verdant greens of Kyoto Racecourse,
the Tenno Sho (Spring) is here once again!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Naturally, all eyes are on Mejiro Bright,who has been delivering one stellar performance after another!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Can she secure consecutive victories even against her stablemate, Mejiro Dober!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah, no.
It's nothing... Nothing at all.

"...Ever since the Fan Appreciation Festival,
Mejiro Dober had been somewhat lost in thought."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. It's the actual race,
so I'll psych myself back up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"My cheeks are tingling...
That presence... it was incredible—"
